name: Conformance: Run-supplied secret witness
description: RFC 0229 §C. One node, 'witness' (typeId core.secret.witness), whose 'ref' and 'expectedSha256' inputs come from the run's inputs of the same names. The client supplies the value with the run (top-level runSecrets on createRun, under a reserved run: ref that resolves only within that run); the node compares the SHA-256 of the resolved value with expectedSha256 and outputs only { matched }. A ref without the run: prefix fails credential_forbidden without resolving anything; an unsupplied run: ref fails credential_not_found. It can only confirm a value the caller already holds, so it is safe to advertise in production. Advertised by every host that advertises secrets.runSecrets. Spec: host-services.md §Run-supplied secrets (v2), capabilities.md §Run-supplied secrets (v1).
